name: Watchmen on Vvardenfell
author: TipsyTekPriest
description: Adds randomised Redoran Watchmen to Vvardenfell. You'll find at least one guarding every Redoran settlement, as well as the road leading to Ghostgate.
usage_notes:
Adds randomised Redoran Watchmen to Vvardenfell! You'll find them in the watchtowers of Ald-Ruhn, Maar Gan and Ald Velothi, and near Gnisis Khuul and the Ghostgate. The Watchmen in this mod have similarstats and inventories to the ones in Tamriel Rebuilt, but are also randomised to include different faces and a chance of going helmetless.

- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/morrowind/mods/44537]Tamriel_Data [/url]for the Redoran Watchman Armor.

name: Sotha Sil is a Dunmer
author: G The Generous
description: A slight tweak for Sotha Sil's texture so that he is no longer an n'wah
usage_notes:
[b]New 2.0 version revamped HD version using Sotha Sil texture from Intelligent Textures 2.1, vanilla version remains the same. Special thanks to Remiros for it![/b]

[b]Description:[/b]
Sotha Sil is the saddest god in the whole TES universe, not only that you can't *ahem* interact with him, Bethesda also didn't even give him a proper unique face, they just took the face texture of corprus stalker then slapped on his already sad and miserable face. And then years later, even though we have mods that make Vivec and Almalexia look like Kim Kardashian and the like, no one still bother to give poor old Sotha some love.

Sotha Sil is a Dunmer is a simple edit to his texture, it mostly remains the same but Sotha Sil's skin is now Dunmer-like with the iconic red eyes, I
also changed the shape of his eyebrows so it looks more elven. I'm not very excellent at texture editing, it's not much but I figured it's better than his abomination vanilla face. This is initially an optional file for my HD Vanilla Textures but as there are now better upscaled textures out there, I think it deserves its own place and I also used a better upscaled texture as a base and reworking it from there.

There are 2 versions: HD and Vanilla, both are in the same file. HD version is for people who use Intelligent Textures or other texture packs, Vanilla version is for vanilla purists because PURITY!!!

[b]Credits:[/b]
Kartoffels for Sotha Sil base texture used for version 1
Remiros for Sotha Sil base texture from IT 2.1

name: Unique faces for Tamriel Data
author: Wolohoo
description: Replaces generic faces in Tamriel Data with unique versions.
usage_notes:
[size=5][b]What?[/b][/size][size=4]
[/size][size=3]A texture replacer for some of the male Nord & Dunmer faces in Tamriel Data.[/size]


[size=5][b]Why?[/b][/size]
[size=3]Tamriel Data asset repository is a wonderful thing, and it has given us many absolutely stunning mods. I love [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/morrowind/mods/42145]Tamriel Rebuilt[/url]﻿ & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/morrowind/mods/44922]Project Cyrodiil[/url]﻿, but [b]especially [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/morrowind/mods/44921]Skyrim Home of the Nords[/url] is very close to my heart as a lifelong Nord Barbarian.

Unfortunately, a few of the newly added faces in Tamriel Data are quite.. placeholder-y and either copypasted or mirrored vanilla heads. It has bothered me for a good long while and I couldn't find any ETA for when they're finished at Tamriel Rebuilt community, so I took it upon myself to learn Morrowind modding to fix this annoyance.

After kitbashing a few faces from existing Tamriel Data & Vanilla resources in Photoshop, I think the result is an OK placeholder.[/size]


[size=5][b]Look?[/b][/size]
[size=3][size=3]Images tab has a clear breakdown on what replaces what!
[/size][/size]

[size=5][b]How?[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Download & install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/morrowind/mods/44537]Tamriel Data[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3]Download desired replacers from downloads tab[/size]
[*][size=3]Extract to where you installed Tamriel Data[/size]
[*][size=3]Allow to replace files[/size]
[/list]



[size=2]Note that this is mainly a personal annoyance fixing mod, and will be redundant in the future once Tamriel Data assets are updated. I figured I'll share this in case anyone else is bothered by this.[/size]

author: VanCrew

name: Atlased Orange Narsis
author: Markond VanCrew
description: Swaps out the vanilla meshes in Orange Narsis for their Project Atlas, MOP, and GITD equivalents.
usage_notes:
[u][b]Description
[/b][/u]

Orange Narsis uses the unatlased vanilla meshes as its base, I just swapped them for their Project Atlas equivalents and made two new atlas textures for them using MET.

The Velothi parts are not an exact 1 to 1 recreation but shouldn't be too noticeably different; the flat part of the temple roof around the dome uses the darker wall texture rather than the patina copper so is more similar to the vanilla design, and the same is true of the tower door.

There is also two meshes that MOP covered that Project Atlas doesn't that were modified and included for completionist sake.

Optional downloads for;
Atlased GITD, as the temple windows and one of the buildings didn't have night lighting.
1k textures, matching White Suran's HD resolution.
Vanilla 256 texture resolution.

[b][u]
Requirements[/u][/b]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/morrowind/mods/57199]Orange Narsis[/url]﻿  ﻿ Overwrite their meshes with my modified ones.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/morrowind/mods/42145]Tamriel Rebuilt[/url]﻿  ﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/morrowind/mods/45399]Project Atlas[/url]﻿  ﻿Not strictly needed, but why would you want atlasing in Narsis without using this?

name: TR Data Painting Edits
author: Dorrmann
description: Edits the textures of the paintings found in TR Data (mainly the Hlaalu portraits) to stand out less.
usage_notes:
Objectively, the paintings in TR are very well made; however, the Hlaalu portraits look like Legends cards.

Each painting has a canvas or oil paint overlay applied to make it look less like it was exported from Procreate. The colors have been desaturated, and the hues adjusted to better match Morrowind's palette.

I personally recommend the downscaled version, as it blends more naturally with the game's established aesthetic.

name: Tamriel Data Water Retextured
author: Silror
description: Give Tamriel Data waters a clean, crystal clear and natural look
usage_notes:
I've always disliked the Tamriel Data water textures, especially with high resolution texture mods, so I gave them (with the help of AI, I must admit) a cleaner, more crystal clear look. I also slightly edited the waterfall textures to make them more transparent.

You can also find another version in the optional files that is closer to vanilla.

Edit : Added OAAB Data version


Only tested with OpenMW

name: Dagoth Ur Blight Cloud Shader Compatibility
author: Leaposter
description: Reduces the size of the blight cloud inside the crater of Red Mountain to improve compatibility with shaders.
usage_notes:
This mod shrinks the size of the special blight cloud that hangs inside the crater of Red Mountain, just outside of Dagoth Ur.

This change helps prevent the blight cloud from clashing with SSAO, Sky, and Cloud shaders, without removing it entirely. See screenshots for before and after.

Also included is a modified version of the Dagoth Cloud texture, which reduces its brightness and increases its transparency. You may wish to use this if you use a sky shader that significantly darkens the skies over Red Mountain and Dagoth Ur.

author: iLikeGothMommys
description: Modifies many of the user-interfaces to remove buttons that are no longer usable when playing OpenMW with the controller support that was added in 0.50
usage_notes:
[center][size=6]Controller Interface Overhaul[u]
[/u][size=6][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][/size]
[/size][size=3]Overhauls the user-interfaces for OpenMW 0.50 to remove many of the buttons that were not functional when using controller support, a few layouts were also rearranged to look more like the OG Xbox. The images are just a small sample of the menus, almost every interface was modified to remove leftover buttons from M&KB mode. This originally started as a modification to the barter menu so I could free up space for extra rows with a larger interface scale, then I expanded it to almost every menu.
[/size][size=6][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][size=6]-[/size][/size]
[size=5]Installation Instructions

name: Speechcraft Rebalance (OpenMW)
author: Aphain
description: Makes leveling speechcraft a better and worthwhile experience. Talk your way to the top!
usage_notes:
For [url=https://openmw.org/]OpenMW[/url]

This mod changes several game modifiers to make leveling speechcraft a more worthwhile and (hopefully) less broken experience.
It also dramatically increases the worth of speechcraft as a major or minor skill by nerfing "ye olde throw money at the problem" method.

Bribe modifers decreased to make bribes more reliant on mercantile and personality than
money to prevent rich characters with low social skills plowing through disposition checks.

[code]fBribe1000Mod 150 -> 125
fBribe100Mod 75 -> 45
fBribe10Mod 35 -> 20[/code]

Personality now has a slightly smaller influence on starting disposition (both positive and negative) 
to leave more room for speechcraft checks.

[code]fDispPersonalityMult 0,5 -> 0,35[/code]

Random dice rolls now have a lower impact on your speechcraft/mercantile checks.
This makes speechcraft/mercantile checks less random and more skill based.

[code]fPerDieRollMult 0,3 -> 0,2[/code]

Minimum success chance increased but minimum change per success decreased so that
leveling speechcraft is easier and has a greater longterm impact compared  to one or two
lucky rolls in a row in vanilla with huge disposition jumps. This also prevents low disposition
traps when you start out with a lower skill level.

[code]iPerMinChance 5 -> 30
iPerMinChange 10 -> 1[/code]

[b]Initial base disposition changes updated:[/b]

Attacking someone is now taken rather seriously by your victim...

[code]fDispAttacking -10 -> -25
[/code]
...and not so much anymore if they see you attacking somebody else.

[code]iDispAttackMod -50 -> -20[/code]

People don't like it when you start sneezing on their boots!

[code]fDispDiseaseMod -10 -> -15
[/code]
Increased same-race disposition bonus:

[code]fDispRaceMod 5 -> 10[/code]

People will now actually take it personally if they see you stealing (this is muliplied by stack value).

[code]fDispStealing -0,5 -> -1[/code]

Pickpocketing someone shouldn't be as bad as attacking them anymore...

[code]fDispPickPocketMod -25 -> -15[/code]

You want to taunt somebody? Draw your weapon before talking to them to lower their starting disposition!

[code]fDispWeaponDrawn -5 -> -10[/code]

Decreased disposition penalty for tresspassing (in vanilla tresspassing is equivalent to attacking two people!)

[code]iDispTresspass -20 -> -10[/code]

For an explanation about how social interactions work in the game see this page:
[url=https://wiki.openmw.org/index.php?title=Research:Disposition_and_Persuasion]Disposition and Personality Research[/url]

name: Tamriel_Data (HD)
author: Cross-Project Coordination
description: The High Definition version of the shared asset repository used by Tamriel Rebuilt, Project Tamriel, and other TESIII mods.
usage_notes:
[size=5]The SD version of Tamriel_Data is available [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/morrowind/mods/44537]here[/url].[/size]

[size=5]Features:[/size]
- Tamriel_Data has served as the shared asset repository for major TESIII projects such as Tamriel Rebuilt, Project Cyrodiil, Skyrim: Home of the Nords, and others, for nearly 10 years.
- Tamriel_Data can be used as a master file for all TESIII mods; please refer to the documentation in the download for detailed information on permissions.
- Deprecated assets are kept in the repository (with the optional ability to hide via [url=https://mwse.github.io/MWSE/references/general/csse/]CSSE[/url]) to greatly reduce the possibility that a mod utilizing Tamriel_Data will break following future asset updates.
- All assets submitted for inclusion in Tamriel_Data undergo a review process to ensure adherence to our project guidelines.

[size=5]Installation Instructions:[/size]
- AVOID SLOW INSTALLATION: After downloading the .7z file, use a compatible program such as 7zip to "Extract" the files into a new folder, then drag those extracted files into your Data Files folder.
- Please note that we can't guarantee that any updates to Tamriel_Data won't break prior save files. We have included a filepatcher and readme in the Docs folder of the download which can be used to attempt to patch your save files.

[size=5]Requirements:[/size]
- BSA registration is no longer a requirement!
- Tamriel_Data requires Morrowind.esm, Tribunal.esm, and Bloodmoon.esm to be active in your load order and timestamped before 1/1/2012 00:00:0000. Most modern installations of TESIII satisfy this requirement by default, so check your load order if you run into any issues.
- Neither MWSE Lua nor OpenMW Lua is required, but either is highly recommended to take advantage of custom spells, weather, sounds, and more. As of August 2026, not all features available in MWSE Lua are currently present in OpenMW Lua.
- [url=https://mwse.github.io/MWSE/references/general/csse/]CSSE[/url] is highly recommended to greatly improve the Construction Set experience.

[size=5]Other Notes:[/size]
- Join us at the Discords for [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/9T6TtNU]Tamriel Rebuilt[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/cCJ9TPb5JA]Project Tamriel[/url] to follow progress and learn more about how you can contribute to PTR.
- Submit bug reports via the [url=https://github.com/TD-Addon/TamrielDataMain/issues]Tamriel_Data GitHub[/url].
- We would like to extend a huge "Thank you!" to all the developers who made Tamriel_Data a reality in 2016, and to all contributors, modders, and players who have joined us since then.

name: Master Index Reloaded - A Better Take on the Master Index Plugin
author: IyaVehk
description: Replaces the official Master Index plugin with an updated quest that enriches the existing propylon network rather than replacing it.
usage_notes:
This mod is an updated take on the original idea of the Master Index official plugin: Folms Mirel giving you a quest to find all the propylon indices and rewarding you with a master index. This mod makes some significant changes from the original, to try and make it mechanically interesting and lore-friendly. 

I've hated the master index plugin since I began playing Morrowind. It takes one of my favorite  features of the game, the propylon stronghold network. and completely steamrolls it. So I decided to try and re-make it from the ground up, keeping the features I liked while making the whole experience much more like the vanilla game.

For starters, the master index itself no longer warps you to Caldera; it simply functions as a master copy of all ten indices on Vvardenfell. Now you get the full experience of stronghold hopping without having to carry 20 pounds of rocks on your person at all times. Secondly, you must be a member of the Mages Guild to access the quest. It never sat right with me that Folms Mirel would team up with just anyone to fulfill his research. Mages Have Standards. And finally, instead of having to turn each. index. in. individually, he gives you the locations of all ten at the start, which you can collect at your convenience, until you turn everything in at once, so you don't accidentally lock yourself out of the network. 

Each index in the game now can be obtained multiple ways. You no longer [i]have[/i] to steal from NPCs if you don't want to. Of course, stealthy characters can still pilfer to their heart's content. Only one of the original 10 indices is no longer in its previous place; the rest have been untouched, with dialogue being the only change. 

COMPATIBILITY:
The Master Index Reloaded plugin is, as you might expect, not compatible with the vanilla Master Index plugin. I would recommend tossing the original straight in the trash even if you don't decide to download this mod. This plugin uses the included model and icon for the Master Index in the GotY edition of Morrowind, which have been included in the download. If you already have the GotY edition with plugins installed, you will not need them, and only need to install the .esp included in this download.

Have fun! This is the most comprehensive mod I have made to date, and it took a lot of time and effort to get everything working like I envisioned. Please enjoy :)
